logical_model.summary: Logical design for datamodel, derived from the conceptual model. 20 entities carry 23 relationships: 2 associative entities resolve many-to-many relationships and 1 entities are identified through a parent. 0 entities required a surrogate identifier because no business key was recorded. Attributes are typed against abstract domains and carry no platform-specific length, precision or storage.

subject_areas.name: Geography
subject_areas.description: Master data for locations where customers, warehouses, and suppliers operate.

subject_areas.name: Organization
subject_areas.description: Internal company structure including employees, departments, and reporting relationships.

subject_areas.name: Product Master
subject_areas.description: Product catalog, categorization, supplier relationships, and inventory management.

subject_areas.name: Sales
subject_areas.description: Customer information, order capture, order line items, and payment processing.

subject_areas.name: Fulfillment
subject_areas.description: Shipment and return processing for orders.

subject_areas.name: Audit & Compliance
subject_areas.description: System audit logging for tracking changes to data.

subject_areas.name: Unassigned
subject_areas.description: Entities the conceptual model placed in no domain.

entities.name: Audit Log
entities.description: System audit trail recording all data modifications for compliance and traceability.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: Product categories used to classify and organize the product catalog (Accessories, Storage, etc.).

entities.name: City
entities.description: Cities within states, the primary geographic unit for customer location and warehouse placement.

entities.name: Country
entities.description: Sovereign nations and territories where the business operates or has customers and suppliers.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: End customers who purchase products and place orders.

entities.name: Department
entities.description: Organizational departments within the company (Finance, Support, etc.) that group employees.

entities.name: Employee
entities.description: Company staff members with role, compensation, and hierarchical reporting structure.

entities.name: Inventory
entities.description: Stock levels of products held at specific warehouses, with reorder thresholds for supply chain management.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: Sales transactions placed by customers, managed by sales representatives and tracked through fulfillment.

entities.name: Order Item
entities.description: Individual line items within an order, specifying products, quantities, and unit prices.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: Payment transactions received for orders, with method and date tracking.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: Goods sold and inventoried by the business, with pricing, supplier sourcing, and category classification.

entities.name: Product Promotion Association
entities.description: Resolves the many-to-many relationship between Product and Promotion. Each occurrence records that one Product references one Promotion.

entities.name: Product Warehouse Association
entities.description: Resolves the many-to-many relationship between Product and Warehouse. Each occurrence records that one Product references one Warehouse.

entities.name: Promotion
entities.description: Discount and promotional campaigns that can be applied to products.

entities.name: Return Order
entities.description: Product returns initiated by customers for orders, with reason tracking.

entities.name: Shipment
entities.description: Shipment records tracking the dispatch of orders from warehouses with tracking information.

entities.name: State
entities.description: States or provinces within countries used for geographic organization of customers and warehouses.

entities.name: Supplier
entities.description: External vendors who supply products to the organization.

entities.name: Warehouse
entities.description: Physical distribution centers that hold inventory and ship orders to customers.

normalization_actions.action: Resolved many-to-many between Product and Promotion
normalization_actions.rationale: A many-to-many relationship cannot be represented without a repeating group. An associative entity keyed on both parents removes the repetition and gives the relationship a place to carry its own attributes later.

normalization_actions.action: Resolved many-to-many between Product and Warehouse
normalization_actions.rationale: A many-to-many relationship cannot be represented without a repeating group. An associative entity keyed on both parents removes the repetition and gives the relationship a place to carry its own attributes later.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Inventory has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, reorder_level) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Item has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, unit_price) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Identified Order Item as dependent on Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Its business key includes Order's key (order_id), so it cannot be identified independently. The relationship is identifying and the key is propagated rather than duplicated.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed State attributes are not repeated on City
normalization_actions.rationale: City references State, which references Country. The chain is already decomposed, so Country's attributes reach City by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed City attributes are not repeated on Customer
normalization_actions.rationale: Customer references City, which references State. The chain is already decomposed, so State's attributes reach Customer by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Inventory
normalization_actions.rationale: Inventory references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Inventory by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Customer attributes are not repeated on Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Order references Customer, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Order by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Order Item
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Item references Order, which references Customer. The chain is already decomposed, so Customer's attributes reach Order Item by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Payment
normalization_actions.rationale: Payment references Order, which references Customer. The chain is already decomposed, so Customer's attributes reach Payment by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Product Warehouse Association
normalization_actions.rationale: Product Warehouse Association references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Product Warehouse Association by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Return Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Return Order references Order, which references Customer. The chain is already decomposed, so Customer's attributes reach Return Order by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Shipment
normalization_actions.rationale: Shipment references Order, which references Customer. The chain is already decomposed, so Customer's attributes reach Shipment by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed City attributes are not repeated on Warehouse
normalization_actions.rationale: Warehouse references City, which references State. The chain is already decomposed, so State's attributes reach Warehouse by navigation rather than by duplication.
